evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Own standards around data quality, lineage, documentation and governance
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Governance, data quality, lineage, documentation and validation language dominate throughout responsibilities with no velocity/shipping-speed framing present.
evidence.domain_risk: Ensure reports, dashboards and AI tools return consistent answers from trusted data sources
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors affect internal business decisions and AI-generated insights but there's no financial reporting, regulatory, or compliance language, placing this at moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: With a strong Data Engineering function already in place
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The JD explicitly describes an existing, established Data Engineering function and a 'wider data team' to mentor, indicating a mature data organization.
evidence.jd_authorship: Create reusable business-ready data models built on Kimball and star-schema principles
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Mix of technically precise bullets (Kimball, star-schema, DAX, M Query) with generic recruiter phrasing and emoji-heavy formatting typical of agency-authored postings (Eden Scott is a recruiting agency).
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: own the semantic layer that sits between raw data and the insights, dashboards and AI tools relied upon across the business
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role's central focus is the semantic layer and data platform serving internal data consumers (dashboards, AI tools, other analysts), an internal_data orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: Have genuine influence on data strategy and technical standards across the business
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role sets best practices, technical standards, and data strategy rather than executing scoped requests — clearly strategic.
evidence.ai_role: Prepare semantic models for Copilot, AI agents and natural-language querying
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to build semantic models, metadata and guardrails specifically so downstream AI systems (Copilot, AI agents) can consume the data — this is ai_enabler; the JD also mentions using AI tools personally, but the stronger enabler signal takes precedence per tie-breaker.
evidence.testing_framing: Own standards around data quality, lineage, documentation and governance
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality and governance are framed as an owned responsibility with action verbs (own, ensure, establish), not just a listed skill.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Challenge assumptions and validate outputs, especially when AI is involved
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Moderate: repeated emphasis on validation and quality control (especially around AI outputs) reflects operational trust concerns, but without regulatory/compliance/audit framing that would push it to high.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Move the business from reactive reporting to productised, self-service analytics
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Mix of building new AI-ready semantic infrastructure (greenfield) while transforming existing reactive/ad-hoc reporting into governed products (fix_scale).
